name: snaprender
title: SnapRender
description: Capture website screenshots and read pages as Markdown. Requires a SnapRender account and API key (a free plan is available).
author: aleksis

commands.name: screenshot-website
commands.title: Screenshot Website
commands.subtitle: SnapRender
commands.description: Capture a screenshot of any public URL with device, full page, dark mode and format options.

commands.name: screenshot-current-tab
commands.title: Screenshot Current Tab
commands.subtitle: SnapRender
commands.description: Capture the page open in your frontmost browser tab and copy the image to the clipboard.

commands.name: read-page
commands.title: Read Page as Markdown
commands.subtitle: SnapRender
commands.description: Extract the readable content of a web page as Markdown.

commands.name: check-usage
commands.title: Check Usage
commands.subtitle: SnapRender
commands.description: Show the captures left this month, your plan and the reset date.

tools.name: take-screenshot
tools.title: Take Screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a public web page. Saves the image to the Downloads folder and returns the file path. Each call uses one monthly capture.

tools.name: read-page
tools.title: Read Page
tools.description: Read the content of a public web page as Markdown. Use it to answer questions about a page or summarize it. Each call uses one monthly capture.

tools.name: get-usage
tools.title: Get Usage
tools.description: Get the SnapRender plan, captures used and left this month, and the date the monthly allowance resets.

ai.instructions: SnapRender renders public web pages. It cannot reach localhost, private networks or pages behind a login. Use read-page to read text and take-screenshot only when the user wants an image. When a result says the monthly captures are used up, do not retry: tell the user the reset date.

evals.input: @snaprender read https://example.com and summarize it in one sentence

read-page.markdown:
# Example Domain

This domain is for use in illustrative examples in documents. You may use this domain in literature without prior coordination or asking for permission.

expected.meetsCriteria: Summarizes the page as a domain meant for illustrative examples

evals.input: @snaprender take a full page screenshot of https://example.com on an iPhone
@snaprender how many captures do I have left this month

preferences.name: apiKey

preferences.description: Your SnapRender API key. Create a free key at https://app.snap-render.com/auth/signup

preferences.name: defaultFormat
preferences.title: Default Format
preferences.description: Image format used when a command does not ask for one.

preferences.name: defaultDevice
preferences.title: Default Device
preferences.description: Device emulated when a command does not ask for one.

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
